basic_info.description: This Eichler home has been thoughtfully updated by the current owners who purchased it from the original owners over 20 years ago. The entry garden and atrium welcome you to a peaceful place. The main living level with Kitchen, Living and Dining areas all opening onto the deck and expansive views of Glen Canyon. New hardwood floors compliment the open beam and original tongue and groove ceilings and original fireplace. Radiant heat is under the floors on both living levels.  Off the kitchen is a flexible space for bedroom or office . The second level includes a Primary en-suite and 2 bedrooms and bath.  In the primary suite bath a soaking tub, double vanity and shower feel like a retreat.  A private courtyard just off the primary  is a hidden sanctuary for morning yoga and meditation. All bedrooms on this level open to outdoor decks and a peaceful view through pine branches.  There is a full laundry center complete with sink and storage.The garden (third) level is a large, clean, open space with many possibilities.  Preliminary  architect plans for expansion are available. An award winning garden includes a series of gardens and courtyards stepping down the hillside. 76 Cameo is a  home made for sanctuary from city life. A home built by a visionary for his time and our time.
